changes.title: Pause on top
items: The pause menu now sits on top of the map, the station menus, the telescope and everything else open, takes your keys and pad, and puts you back where you were when you resume

changes.title: Station fixes
items: At the wardrobe, dressing table, shoe rack and the other stations, the camera now frames you whole, on the part you're choosing (your head, your top, your shoes), instead of aiming at your feet with your head off screen; zooming in first no longer pushes it closer still

On a gamepad at a station, the bottom face button chooses (it used to fly you off), the d-pad or the right stick moves through the menu, and only the left stick walks you; on a keyboard, Enter, E or Space chooses
Landing on an item you own still puts it on straight away; choosing one you haven't found yet says so
A look you chose at the dressing table no longer gets swapped back for an older one if you changed your mind quickly

changes.title: Packs temperate
items: Beavers and stags fight as packs now: they take turns, combo their moves and fall back between attacks

changes.title: Packs mountains
items: Frost wyrms, lynxes, red pandas and snow leopards fight as packs now: they take turns, combo their moves and fall back between attacks

changes.title: Packs cold
items: Arctic foxes, elk, frost trolls, penguins and polar bears fight as packs now: they take turns, combo their moves and fall back between attacks

changes.title: Packs cold rainforest
items: Black bears, flying squirrels and roe deer fight as packs now: they take turns, combo their moves and fall back between attacks

changes.title: No takeoff in house
items: In the treehouse she can only take off from the Terrace: pressing rise (Space, or X on a gamepad) while pushed up against a room's wall, at the wardrobe say, no longer lifts her out of the bedroom
